title: hsk30: grading Chinese text against either document called HSK 3.0
description:
“HSK 3.0” names two different official documents: the GF0025-2021 national grading standard, in force since July 2021, and the examination syllabus published in November 2025 and in force since July 2026. They assign different levels to 41.5% of the words and 40.7% of the characters they share, and grading real texts against one rather than the other changes the level of roughly half of them.

This release contains a dependency-free Python library that grades Chinese text against either document and records which; a validated extraction of the 2025 examination syllabus from the official 406-page PDF; an aligned corpus of 102 graded readers with per-word pinyin and gloss plus a disjoint 30-text held-out split; and HSKBench, a difficulty-controlled generation benchmark in which the grader serves as the metric rather than as the source of labels.

Software is MIT licensed; the corpus is CC BY 4.0 and carries a datasheet disclosing LLM-assisted authorship.
